sentences: A linear extension is a total ordering consistent with all comparisons in a given partial order.
The task is to count these compatible orderings exactly.
This differs from finding one ordering, because the output must account for every possible way incomparable elements can interleave.
Sharper algorithms would improve exact combinatorial counting for precedence systems and clarify its exponential complexity.
